items.title: Jakobi Meyers: Has hamstring, ankle injuries
items.text:
Meyers was listed as limited on Monday's estimated injury report due to hamstring and ankle issues.

items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Works with starters in warmups
items.text:
Charbonnet was "the first running back getting handoffs" during warmups before Monday's game against the Bears, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Unlikely for Thursday
items.text:
Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Huntley (toe) "probably" won't play Thursday versus the Jaguars, and the Ravens then will "see how it goes from a long-term standpoint."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Fagnano: Chance to play Thursday
items.text:
Coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Fagnano (knee) "is fighting through a couple things" but has a chance to play Thursday against the Jaguars.
